Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that the WebSurfer's initial search result (which was a DuckDuckGo search results page) confirmed the mother's name as Bertha of Blois. The Planner failed to verify that the specific text "Conan was the eldest child and heir of Alan III, Duke of Brittany by his wife Bertha of Blois" was actually visible in the viewport provided by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer's report explicitly stated that the visible text in the viewport was limited to the browser's UI elements (upgrade prompts, menu options) and the search result links, but did not quote the actual content of the Wikipedia article snippet that contains the parentage information. By accepting this unverified information as confirmed fact without asking for the specific text to be read or by misinterpreting the WebSurfer's limited viewport description, the Planner made a premature logical leap. This error propagated through the rest of the conversation, leading the team to confidently conclude the mother's identity and date of death based on a source they never actually read.
